claim: When crypto and stocks dump together, most people sell and Mike buys, because a dump is where the low entries are, and low entries are how he plans to make millions by 2028.
why_this_claim: It is the thesis of the longform's own engineered hook (CH1 beats 1, 3 and 4), closed with the locked goal line of CH5. It needs none of the other ten minutes: no recap of why the market fell, no software, no loop. One stance (they sell, I buy), one receipt a viewer can read off his own chart (Pieverse, called around a 65 million cap, went over a billion), one rule (I need low entries), one goal. What is left out (the five causes, how the software finds the plays, the loop) is exactly what the CTA sends the viewer to the full video for.

And a market like this is where my low entries come from. It finds them early, then I swing trade them. Buy the bottoms, sell the pumps, then rotate the profits into the next one (BR-2 then the H1 kinetic card). The best alternative body line.
